acceptance.uncertainty: 95percent source-group bootstrap confidence intervals (2000 deterministic resamples) plus per-category counts; only140 rooms and minimum50instances/class may leave wide intervals. Point-target attainment alone is not proof the population rate exceeds the target.

annotations.Chair: ordinary chairs, seating stools, bar stools
annotations.cabinet: Whole freestanding cabinet; fronts, built-in wall storage or multi-unit assemblies require explicit policy and ambiguity flags
annotations.lamp: Whole standalone floor/table lamp; ceiling lights and attached fixtures excluded or separately labeled
annotations.quality: Independent second annotator on all category identities and uncertain boxes, at least20percent double box annotation, disagreement adjudication without model predictions; explicit per-category completeness
annotations.table_desk: Native purpose and whole-object identity; ambiguous work/dining surfaces explicitly ignored, never silently remapped
annotations.visibility: Record truncation, occlusion, crowd/group and minimum size; annotate all discernible instances; uncertain or unresolvable regions ignored, not negatives

metrics: Matched-recall precision as descriptive comparison only
TP/FP/FN, duplicates, fragmentation and localization by category
frozen_protocol.models: Immutable original and one preselected experimental checkpoint; one controlled comparison; no repeated acceptance-set optimization
frozen_protocol.preprocessing: Pinned original OWLv2 processor with exact box transform
frozen_protocol.threshold_selection: Any operating-point calibration requires a separate development set; freeze before acceptance images are scored

isolation: Exact image/source hashes, COCO/Open Images/LVIS IDs, creator/source groups and near-duplicates checked against all training and exposed development material
Entire room/property/capture session and known family remain in one group; unresolved identity relationships quarantined
No evaluation image or annotation used to construct negative training targets or tune prompts/thresholds
resource_and_authorization: No photographs acquired or annotated by this proposal. Exact source manifest, transfer/storage and annotation cost require separate approval; no evaluation is run now.
rights: Individually authorized photographs or independently verified commercially compatible rights, attribution and source evidence required before acquisition.
sampling: Freeze source-stratified room/camera selection before model outputs; no catalogue or synthetic evaluation images. Do not select using detector scores.
scope: Future independent real-room acceptance, separate from every exposed internal or historical panel
